events.head: Check push state, resolver references, audit rows and publish log
events.input: $ git fetch origin -q 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "ahead/behind: $(git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...main)"; git log --oneline -3 origin/main; echo ---RESOLVER; grep -n "seatLink\|SEAT_URL\|SESSION_._URL\|ownSeat\|heldFeedToken" -r app/src cloud/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | cut -c1-170 | head -50; echo ---AUDIT; for i in M070 O013 M034 M050 M033 M052 M054 M061 O011; do grep -n "^| $i " /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | awk -F'|' '{print $2 "|" substr($(NF-1),1,150)}'; done; echo ---HELD; grep -n -i "publish held\|PUBLISHED" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-co
